episodes.synopsis: Takasugi enters the fray, and he and the Kiheitai change the entire dynamic of the battle in the Heavenly Bird.
episodes.title: The Evildoers Who Do Good

episodes.synopsis: Kagura senses Yato presence and runs off to stop them, and she has some unexpected backup!
episodes.title: Rabbits Jump High on Moonlit Nights

episodes.synopsis: With the Earth's Altana reserves going berserk, and the Flame of Kagutsuchi nearly ready to fire, the Kiheitai are left with hard choices to make in order to prevent the destruction of Earth and the entire galaxy.
episodes.title: Making a Dull World Interesting

episodes.synopsis: Ensho's past is revealed, and Takasugi revolves to make a final stand to take him down.
episodes.title: Do Something Uncharacteristic, and Something Uncharacteristic Will Happen

episodes.synopsis: The story shifts back to Earth, where Utsuro has made the Altana ley lines go berserk. Some old, familiar faces rise up to combat it.
episodes.title: Countless Kings

episodes.synopsis: Shijaku presents his brother, Prince Hata, with an impossible choice. As he finally makes his decision, Hasegawa suggests a different solution.
episodes.title: The Unemployed Cannot Be Stained By Anything

episodes.synopsis: As Sadaharu fights to quell the rampaging ley lines, the gang puts it all on the line to take down Utsuro.
episodes.title: Always Hold On to Your Trump Cards

episodes.synopsis: The Odd Jobs are joined by old friends in their battle to save the Earth. Utsuro is surprised by a side of humanity he had never seen before.
episodes.title: The Creatures Known as Humanity

episodes.synopsis: Two years have passed, and Gintoki has shut down the Odd Jobs business and gone off to do something only he can do. Shinpachi has other ideas, though.
episodes.title: Sign

episodes.synopsis: Shinpachi is forced into a plot to assassinate the inaugural prime minister of Japan, Donald Zuramp!
episodes.title: Specter

episodes.synopsis: Okita and Kagura's daughter (?) rekindle their rivalry, and Okita senses something is off. Meanwhile, Gintoki runs into an old friend.
episodes.title: Two in Girl Years Is Equal to Ten in Man Years

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki and Takasugi reveal to each other what they've been doing over the past two years, and decide to go save the one thing they never managed to save in the past: their teacher.
episodes.title: Salvation

episodes.synopsis: Now back in Edo, Gintoki doesn't know how to face his old friends, and so he decides to try and avoid running into any of them. However, that won't be easy.
episodes.title: Dun Dun

episodes.synopsis: Having caught Takasugi Shinsfake, the ladies' gang decides to teach him a lesson and try and get him to spill the beans on where Gintoki is. How will Shinsfake survive this?
episodes.title: There Are Lines Even Villains Can't Cross
